item.title: Aito Is China's Best-Selling Luxury New Energy Vehicle Brand
item.description: Aito cements itself as China’s best-selling luxury brand. In 2025, Seres’ high-end new energy vehicle brand saw its sales exceed 470,000 units. The feat enables them to beat out Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz in the process.Read More »

item.title: China Becomes First Country In The World To Ban Hidden Door Handles
item.description: China takes the lead in vehicle safety as it becomes the first country in the world to ban concealed door handles.Read More »

item.title: First-Ever Nissan Festival Is Officially Largest Gathering Of Nissan Car Clubs And Fans In The Philippines
item.description: Nissan Philippines made history with its first-ever Nissan Festival at the Clark International Speedway last February 1. True to its theme “Driven by Passion, Powered by Legacy,” the event brought together over 1,700 enthusiasts and served as the largest official gathering of Nissan car clubs and fans in the country, transforming the speedway into a hub for performance and heritage.Read More »

item.title: Kawasaki PH Commands 61.5 Percent Share In Tricycle Segment
item.description: Kawasaki Philippines further strengthened its leadership in the Philippine tricycle segment in 2025, commanding a 61.5 percent market share, supported by a 14.8 percent year-on-year growth. The brand’s continued expansion in the segment outpaced overall tricycle market growth, reinforcing Kawasaki’s position as the preferred motorcycle brand for livelihood and utility use nationwide.Read More »

item.title: 2026 GWM Haval H9 Brings 4x4 Capability And Confidence At 4x2 Price (w/ Specs)
item.description: GWM Philippines is ready for primetime with the launch of their most ambitious offering yet: the GWM Haval H9. Positioned as their new flagship offering, this mid-sized 7-seater SUV brings space, safety, and confident 4x4 power—all for the price of a traditional 4x2. Watch our first impressions.Read More »

item.title: For The First Time Ever, Honda Isn't Offering A Manual Gearbox In The Philippines Anymore
item.description: Throughout the decades, Honda is known commonly for its driver-centric character and central to that tenet is a slick manual gearbox. Well, here’s some sad news for all you Honda fans and enthusiasts out there to greet 2026: Honda Cars Philippines has phased out it throughout its local line-up.Read More »
